carries: a UIKit pan has no minimum distance, so the row twitched on the two or three points of movement that come with an ordinary tap and then snapped back: nothing moves under twelve points now, and the travel is measured from there
the hand-written springs ignored Reduce Motion while the rest of the app honours it through Tone.soft; the row uses the same helper, so the return is silent when the setting is on
a rightward drag reset the offset with no animation at all, a hard jump; every return goes through one path
committing is judged on how far the ROW travelled rather than the finger, so the dead zone does not shift the threshold
